title: On Bonart's interpretation of the Square-Root Impact Law
abstract: arXiv:2610.10053v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The square-root impact law (SRIL), $I = Y\sigma\sqrt{Q/V}$, bundles two facts that a single mechanism must explain at once: a shape (impact proportional to square-root of traded volume $Q$) and an amplitude ($Y=O(1)$, independent of the participation rate $\varphi$). Bonart has recently proposed an elegant solution: if realized and counterfactual prices are both diffusive, information-neutral impact must have white increments and the SRIL follows without the wart. We reformulate and simplify his argument, and foreground the ingredient he himself regards as essential --- that the market whitens the stationary stream of each participant's metaorders, not any isolated one. The Lillo--Mike--Farmer model satisfies his premises, yet gives an isolated metaorder the super-square-root impact $\varphi^{(1-\gamma)/2}Q^{(1+\gamma)/2}$, $\gamma\in(0,1)$, because single metaorders (i.e. not part of a stream) are statistically invisible and thus priced

translated_title: 论Bonart对平方根冲击定律的诠释
translated_abstract: 平方根冲击定律（SRIL），$I = Y\sigma\sqrt{Q/V}$，将两个事实捆绑在一起，而单一机制必须同时解释二者：一个是形状（冲击与交易量 $Q$ 的平方根成正比），另一个是幅度（$Y=O(1)$，与参与率 $\varphi$ 无关）。Bonart最近提出了一个优雅的解决方案：如果已实现价格与反事实价格都是扩散性的，那么信息中性的冲击必须具有白噪声增量，SRIL便随之自然成立，而无需任何“瑕疵”。我们重新表述并简化了他的论证，并突出强调他本人认为至关重要的要素——市场是对每个参与者平稳的元订单流（而非任何孤立的元订单）进行“白化”处理。Lillo–Mike–Farmer模型满足他的前提条件，然而对于孤立的元订单却给出了超平方根冲击 $\varphi^{(1-\gamma)/2}Q^{(1+\gamma)/2}$，其中 $\gamma\in(0,1)$，原因在于单个元订单（即不属于流的一部分）在统计上是不可见的，因而其定价……
tldr: 本文重新表述并简化了Bonart对平方根冲击定律的推导，强调市场对每个参与者平稳元订单流的白化是关键前提，并指出Lillo–Mike–Farmer模型中孤立的元订单因在统计上不可见而呈现超平方根冲击行为。
en_tdlr: This paper reformulates and simplifies Bonart's derivation of the square-root impact law, emphasizing that the market's whitening of each participant's stationary metaorder stream is the essential ingredient, and shows that isolated metaorders in the Lillo–Mike–Farmer model exhibit super-square-root impact due to their statistical invisibility.
